SiteState.title: SiteState
SiteState.description: Global site configuration, books showcase, banners, tabs, subpages, footer, theme, and page item collections.

siteContent.description: Structured map containing site texts, booksCovers, customBlocks, banners, tabs, socialLinks, footer, theme, and customSubPages.

subpagesContent.description: Map of subpage IDs to arrays of subpage items.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

updatedBy.description: UID of the verified admin who performed the update.

CloneState.title: CloneState
CloneState.description: Isolated cloned website/app configuration owned by a Co-Admin's Google account without affecting site_state/main.

siteContent.description: Cloned siteContent map edited independently by the Co-Admin.

subpagesContent.description: Cloned subpagesContent map edited independently by the Co-Admin.

ownerUid.description: Firebase UID of the Google-synced Co-Admin owning this clone, or empty until claimed.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last clone update.

updatedBy.description: UID of the verified user who performed the update.

CoAdminProfile.title: CoAdminProfile
CoAdminProfile.description: Primary-Admin-managed directory record for Co-Admin accounts.

CoAdminToken.title: CoAdminToken
CoAdminToken.description: PII-free SHA-256 credential token document keyed by hash(email + password) for Co-Admin login verification on clone links.

CoAdminSyncProfile.title: CoAdminSyncProfile
CoAdminSyncProfile.description: PII-isolated Google cloud sync metadata for a Co-Admin UID.

Comment.title: Comment
Comment.description: Visitor or admin comment on a subpage.

AdminProfile.title: AdminProfile
AdminProfile.description: Explicit admin UID document for RBAC verification.

BlogPost.title: BlogPost
BlogPost.description: Rich blog article authored by a verified site admin containing headline, excerpt, and ordered text/image/video blocks.

blocks.description: Ordered array of blog content blocks (text, image, video).

/site_state/{stateId}.description: Stores the global siteContent and subpagesContent synchronized across devices and shared URLs.

/clone_states/{cloneId}.description: Stores isolated cloned siteContent and subpagesContent owned and cloud-synced by a Co-Admin.

/co_admin_tokens/{tokenHash}.description: PII-free SHA-256 token lookup for Co-Admin credential verification.

/co_admin_sync/{uid}.description: Private Google cloud sync metadata per Co-Admin UID.

/admins/{uid}.description: Admin role markers keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/blogs/{blogId}.description: Stores published blog articles readable by visitors and writable exclusively by verified Primary Admins.
